professionalSummary: Experienced refit project manager with a proven track record of delivering four cohorts of twelve branches each from survey to reopening on agreed schedules, managing budgets, resolving clashes, preparing readiness packs, and closing refits with snagging lists and certificates.
experienceHighlights: Managed four cohorts of twelve branches each from survey to reopening on schedules agreed with property team and fit-out contractor (src_0d574b46f683).
Tracked every branch's cost against cohort budget using programme cost tool and reported fortnightly to refit steering group; all 48 branches closed within budget at cohort level (src_0428191bcacd).
Resolved clashes between fit-out and branches' IT and cash-handling changes via programme clash log with sign-off from IT and cash-handling teams (src_ab47ef4c5fd7).
Prepared reopening readiness packs for each branch, documenting regional director's decision and delineating checks performed by self and branch operations (src_934c6a7d9bf6).
Closed each branch refit with snagging list agreed with contractor and reopening certificate countersigned by branch manager (src_f3bac4d099c0).
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample includes one cohort schedule, cost tool extract for one cohort, reopening readiness pack with regional director's decision, and snagging list with reopening certificate, with programme cost tool references as verification trail (src_ae0b8dc4be74).
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample documents establish the candidate’s experience and achievements in managing branch refit projects, tracking costs, resolving clashes, preparing readiness packs, and closing refits with snagging lists and certificates. decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate meets all listed requirements based on provided evidence; human review recommended to verify authenticity of work samples.

evidence.text: Refit project manager at a high-street bank from 2022 to 2025, taking four cohorts of twelve branches each from survey to reopening on schedules agreed with the property team and the fit-out contractor.
Tracked every branch's cost against the cohort budget in the programme cost tool and reported fortnightly to the refit steering group; the forty-eight branches closed within budget at cohort level.
Resolved the clashes between the fit-out and the branches' IT and cash-handling changes through the programme's clash log, with the IT and cash-handling teams' sign-off recorded against each clash.

Prepared the reopening readiness pack for each branch; the reopening decision was the regional director's, recorded on the pack together with the checks that were mine and the checks that were branch operations'.
Closed each branch refit with the snagging list agreed with the contractor and the reopening certificate countersigned by the branch manager.
